snippet.title: Goblin and Recipes: Match-3 Adventure (gameplay trailer)
snippet.description:
Today I'm happy to announce Goblin and Recipes, a cozy fantasy Match-3 puzzle game inspired by traditional Balkan cuisine.

wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4939700/Goblin_and_Recipes_Match3_Adventure/

Swap ingredients, complete increasingly challenging levels, unlock authentic recipes, and discover a whimsical goblin cookbook along the way. It was designed as a relaxing game that's easy to pick up, while still offering enough challenge for players chasing perfect three-star runs.

This release has a bit of a story behind it.

Over the past year I experimented with several small-scope game prototypes to explore different ideas and improve my workflow. Two of those prototypes eventually grew into complete Steam games: Goblin Solitaire and Goblin and Recipes.

I chose to release Goblin Solitaire first because it reached the finish line earlier, while Goblin and Recipes spent a little more time being polished with the help of testers and community feedback. Many of the improvements in this release—including animations, quality-of-life changes, and bug fixes—came directly from that testing process.

With this release, that little series of prototypes comes to an end. There isn't another small project quietly waiting in the kitchen this time.

Now it's finally time to return to larger projects.

As always, thank you to everyone who tested the game, reported bugs, shared suggestions, and helped shape the final version. I hope you enjoy cooking alongside our little goblin chef!
